name: FAQ, featured question
description: The most asked question answered at length with the author’s name, beside a compact accordion of other questions.

fields.name: featuredQuestion
fields.label: Question
fields.default: Is AI going to replace our researchers?

fields.name: featuredAnswer
fields.label: Answer
fields.default:
No, and we built Fieldnote so it can’t. It transcribes, tags and finds patterns across hundreds of hours, which is the part of the job nobody misses.

Deciding which questions to ask, reading between the lines and convincing a roadmap meeting still takes a person. Our customers run twice as many interviews after switching, with the same team.

default.question: Do you train models on our interviews?
default.answer: Never. Your recordings are used only to serve your workspace.

default.question: How long does setup take?
default.answer: About ten minutes, and most teams record their first interview the same day.

default.question: Can we bring old research in?
default.answer: Yes. Upload recordings, transcripts or notes, and they are tagged like new ones.

default.question: Is there a plan for one researcher?
default.answer: Solo is $24 a month and includes 20 recorded hours.
